premise: What if someone drained all the oceans? (a giant cosmic cow god drinks them; the consequences are real, sourced science)
title:
WHAT IF A COW
DRANK THE
OCEANS?

lines.text: What if a giant cosmic cow drank every ocean on Earth?
Golden halo. A hide full of galaxies. And one very long straw.
That's about one point three billion cubic kilometres of seawater. Slurp.

facts.claim: USGS: of the world's water, about 1,338,000,000 km³ is stored in oceans.

lines.text: Water covered seventy one percent of the planet. Now it's bare rock.

facts.claim: USGS: about 71 percent of the Earth's surface is water-covered.

lines.text: Sea level falls, and every ship is left sitting on the sand.
You could walk to America, over the longest mountain range on Earth. The mid ocean ridge, nearly sixty five thousand kilometres long.

facts.claim: NOAA Ocean Exploration: the mid-ocean ridge system is the longest mountain range on Earth, nearly 65,000 km.
facts.quote2: forms the longest and largest mountain range on Earth

lines.text: And the deepest point of the Mariana Trench sits almost eleven kilometres down.

facts.claim: NOAA: Challenger Deep, the deepest point in the Mariana Trench, is approximately 10,935 meters deep.

lines.text: Then the chain reaction. Oceans supply about ninety percent of the water that evaporates. No ocean, no clouds, no rain. Rivers and lakes dry up.

facts.claim: USGS: the oceans supply about 90 percent of the evaporated water that goes into the water cycle.
facts.quote: the oceans supply about 90 percent of the evaporated water

lines.text: The ocean also soaked up about ninety percent of the extra heat from warming. Without it, temperatures swing wildly.

facts.claim: NASA: about 90% of the excess heat from planetary warming over the past century has been absorbed by the ocean.
facts.quote: About 90% of the excess heat from planetary warming over the past century has been absorbed by the ocean

lines.text: And roughly half of our oxygen is made in the ocean. Gone.

facts.claim: NOAA: roughly half of the oxygen production on Earth comes from the ocean.
facts.quote: roughly half of the oxygen production on Earth comes from the ocean

lines.text: Luckily, the cow finally tastes it. Seawater is about three and a half percent salt.

facts.claim: NOAA: about 3.5 percent of the weight of seawater comes from the dissolved salts.
facts.quote: about 3.5 percent of the weight of seawater comes from the dissolved salts

lines.text: So it burps, spits every drop back, and asks for a refill.
